<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: Use the </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Table of Contents</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> present at the bottom of the channel, or in the pinned comments, to quickly navigate through this channel and find the information you are looking for.</nowiki></em></p>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Some general notes:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The game runs on an internal tick system: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1t (tick) = 0.6s (seconds)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The minimum time between abilities is called the global cooldown: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1 gcd = 3t = 1.8s</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Debuff spells like Vuln </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1" alt="Vuln" title="Vuln" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Enfeeble </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1" alt="Enfeeble" title="Enfeeble" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Smoke Cloud </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> do not give adrenaline.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Some useful sheets and resources are given below.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

This is affected by factors such as your gear and other boosts.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Ability Hit Timings</nowiki></u><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Every ability cast applies a stack:
    • Caps at 5 stacks, and at max stacks uses no runes on ability casts
    • Stacks are lost after 20s, refreshed upon applying another stack
    • Each stack reduces Tsunami's </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cast cost by -12% adrenaline
⬥ Frost Surge:
    • At 5 stacks, ability casts trigger Frost Surge; deals 10-50% ability damage
    • Triggering it costs runes even at max stacks
    • Frost Surge is a 5x5 AoE around your primary target which hits up to 8 extra targets in range for 10-50% ability damage each
    • Frost Surge has a 12s cooldown, after an ability cast can trigger it again
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Applies a flat damage reduction:
    • Reduction based on 10% of equipped magic tank gear's armour + 25% of your current Defence </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="Defence" title="Defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level after any buffs or debuffs
    • Damage reduced cannot exceed 60% of the damage taken
    • 60% cap is based off the damage after all other damage reductions such as deflect prayers (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="DeflectRange" title="DeflectRange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) on the hit
⬥ Lasts 12 minutes
⬥ Does not reduce </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> HP / adrenaline gain
⬥ A calculator can be found </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Animate_Dead <nowiki>here</nowiki>]<nowiki>

</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Cooldown: 12t (7.2s)

    • Next </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to hit within 10t of the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cast will have remaining hits instantly hit at 25% more damage
    • Within 10t means: if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is cast t0, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> has to hit within t0-9
        ⬩ Latest you can cast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is t7
⬥ It is affected by the Dragonrider Amulet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656785090994503700.png?v=1" alt="drider" title="drider" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Boosts damage by 10%
